answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent bends like a willow under checks and stands, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a tide of a thousand copies costs a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup. An opal record of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
